eEwm6vHRrU.id: Cross margin membuat harga likuidasi terus bergeser

AuQJk63xBb.en: In isolated mode, only the margin you assigned backs the position and the liquidation price behaves the way a calculator predicts. In cross mode your entire account balance backs it, so the liquidation price is not a property of that trade alone - every other position you hold, and every unrealized gain or loss, moves it. Open a second cross position and the first one's liquidation price shifts, without you touching it.
AuQJk63xBb.id: Di mode isolated, hanya margin yang kamu alokasikan yang menopang posisi, dan harga likuidasinya berperilaku persis seperti prediksi kalkulator. Di mode cross, seluruh saldo akunmu yang menopangnya, jadi harga likuidasi bukan milik trade itu saja - setiap posisi lain yang kamu pegang, dan setiap untung atau rugi yang belum terealisasi, ikut menggesernya. Buka posisi cross kedua, dan harga likuidasi posisi pertama ikut bergeser tanpa kamu sentuh.

ah0I3YWohL.en: This is the single most common source of "why did I get liquidated there?" on Hyperliquid. If you want a liquidation price you can plan against, use isolated margin; if you want one large position to have the whole account as a buffer, use cross and accept that the number is dynamic. Read the mechanics in cross vs isolated margin.
ah0I3YWohL.id: Inilah sumber paling umum dari pertanyaan "kenapa aku kena likuidasi di situ?" di Hyperliquid. Kalau kamu mau harga likuidasi yang bisa dijadikan patokan rencana, pakai isolated margin; kalau kamu mau satu posisi besar punya seluruh akun sebagai penyangga, pakai cross dan terima bahwa angkanya dinamis. tzNr2SK7F8.en: How does liquidation work on Hyperliquid?
tzNr2SK7F8.id: Bagaimana cara kerja likuidasi di Hyperliquid?

bE7TGPC2dt.en: A position is liquidated when its margin falls below the maintenance requirement, measured against an oracle mark price rather than the last trade on the book. Hyperliquid's maintenance margin is half of the initial margin at maximum leverage, so on a 40x asset the maintenance requirement is 1.25% of position value. If the liquidation cannot be filled on the book, the HLP vault takes the position over, and in extreme cases auto-deleveraging closes it against profitable traders on the other side.
bE7TGPC2dt.id: Sebuah posisi dilikuidasi saat margin-nya turun di bawah syarat maintenance, diukur terhadap mark price oracle, bukan transaksi terakhir di order book. Maintenance margin Hyperliquid adalah setengah dari margin awal pada leverage maksimum, jadi di aset 40x syarat maintenance-nya 1.25% dari nilai posisi. Kalau likuidasi tidak bisa tereksekusi di order book, vault HLP mengambil alih posisinya, dan dalam kasus ekstrem auto-deleveraging menutupnya melawan trader yang sedang untung di sisi seberang.

jO0T0QloxX.en: Hyperliquid liquidates against its oracle mark price, which is built from several external spot venues, not from the last trade on Hyperliquid itself. That is deliberate: it stops a thin book or a single wick from triggering liquidations, but it also means your position can be closed while the Hyperliquid chart never printed your liquidation level.
jO0T0QloxX.id: Hyperliquid melikuidasi berdasarkan mark price oracle-nya, yang dibentuk dari beberapa exchange spot eksternal, bukan dari transaksi terakhir di Hyperliquid sendiri. Ini disengaja: order book yang tipis atau satu sumbu (wick) saja tidak bisa memicu likuidasi, tapi artinya posisimu juga bisa ditutup padahal chart Hyperliquid tidak pernah menyentuh level likuidasimu.

p2vAJF1RmO.en: What is the HLP vault and what does it do in a liquidation?
p2vAJF1RmO.id: Apa itu vault HLP dan apa perannya saat likuidasi?

PQTJzYcEFA.en: HLP is Hyperliquid's protocol-owned liquidity vault. When a liquidation cannot be absorbed by the order book at an acceptable price, HLP takes the position onto its own book and works out of it. That is why HLP's profit and loss swings hardest during cascades: it is standing on the other side of forced flow.
PQTJzYcEFA.id: HLP adalah vault likuiditas milik protokol Hyperliquid. Saat sebuah likuidasi tidak bisa diserap order book di harga yang wajar, HLP memindahkan posisi itu ke neraca miliknya sendiri lalu menutupnya pelan-pelan. Itu sebabnya untung-rugi HLP berayun paling keras saat rentetan likuidasi: HLP berdiri di sisi seberang arus paksa.

0zlnGhMTLZ.id: Apakah auto-deleveraging (ADL) bisa terjadi di Hyperliquid?

Z9Sxish0ur.en: Yes. If a liquidated position cannot be closed on the book and the backstop cannot absorb it either, the protocol reduces the opposing positions of profitable, highly leveraged traders to keep the system solvent. It is rare and it is the last line of defence, but it means a winning position can be closed without your instruction.
Z9Sxish0ur.id: Bisa. Kalau posisi yang dilikuidasi tidak bisa ditutup di order book dan penyangganya juga tidak sanggup menyerapnya, protokol memangkas posisi lawan milik trader yang sedang untung dengan leverage tinggi agar sistem tetap solven. Ini jarang terjadi dan merupakan garis pertahanan terakhir, tapi artinya posisi yang sedang menang bisa ditutup tanpa perintahmu.

W3HHo3tVmn.en: Injective is a fast-moving DeFi large-cap; liquidation arrives quickly at high leverage. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most INJ perpetuals). INJ futures list up to 50× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
W3HHo3tVmn.id: Injective adalah large-cap DeFi yang bergerak cepat; di leverage tinggi, likuidasi datang dengan cepat. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menggerus habis margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melebihi jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin adalah Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai rasio maintenance margin (sekitar 0.5% di sebagian besar perpetual INJ). Futures INJ tersedia hingga leverage 50× di berbagai exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat harga likuidasi ke entry-mu.

vOQfHY10rL.en: Liquidation clusters are where forced orders pile up, and price is drawn toward them like a magnet - a large band of INJ long liquidations below spot is fuel for a flush lower, while a wall of short liquidations above is fuel for a squeeze higher. Many traders use the map to (1) avoid entering just above a thick long-liquidation band, (2) anticipate where a cascade might accelerate or exhaust, and (3) place take-profits just ahead of a cluster rather than inside it. DB-6Yw7AIW.en: Positive funding means longs pay shorts. More money wants leveraged exposure to the upside than to the downside, so the perpetual trades above spot and the funding payment drags it back. Negative funding means shorts pay longs: the crowd is positioned for a fall, the perpetual trades below spot, and holding a long is being subsidised.
DB-6Yw7AIW.id: Funding positif berarti long membayar short. Lebih banyak uang yang mau eksposur ber-leverage ke arah naik daripada ke arah turun, jadi harga perpetual berada di atas spot dan pembayaran funding menariknya kembali. Funding negatif berarti short membayar long: mayoritas sedang bersiap untuk penurunan, harga perpetual berada di bawah spot, dan menahan long justru disubsidi.

1RTaAPAyZo.en: The rate is charged periodically - every eight hours on most venues, hourly on Hyperliquid - on the full notional of the position, not on the margin. That is the part people miss. A 0.05% rate on a position opened with ten times leverage costs 0.5% of the money actually posted, every funding period. Carry a crowded long for a week at an elevated rate and funding alone can eat a double-digit percentage of the stake before price does anything at all.
1RTaAPAyZo.id: Rate dikenakan secara berkala - setiap delapan jam di kebanyakan exchange, setiap jam di Hyperliquid - atas seluruh nilai nosional posisi, bukan atas margin. Bagian inilah yang sering terlewat. Rate 0.05% pada posisi dengan leverage sepuluh kali memakan 0.5% dari uang yang benar-benar disetor, setiap periode funding. Tahan long yang sedang ramai selama seminggu di rate tinggi, dan funding saja bisa menggerus dua digit persen modalmu sebelum harga bergerak sama sekali.

-qNzeRU6Jb.en: Mild positive funding is the resting state of a healthy market and says nothing. What is worth noticing is the extreme: a rate several times its own normal level means leverage is crowded on one side and is paying dearly to stay there, which is the condition a squeeze needs. It is a positioning gauge, not a timing signal - funding can sit extended for days while price keeps going the way the crowd wanted.
-qNzeRU6Jb.id: Funding positif yang tipis adalah kondisi normal pasar yang sehat dan tidak berarti apa-apa. Yang perlu diperhatikan adalah titik ekstremnya: rate yang beberapa kali lipat dari level normalnya berarti leverage menumpuk di satu sisi dan membayar mahal untuk tetap di sana - kondisi yang dibutuhkan untuk squeeze. Ini pengukur posisi pasar, bukan sinyal timing - funding bisa bertahan tinggi berhari-hari sementara harga terus bergerak ke arah yang diinginkan mayoritas.

7yP2FF1V_i.en: The other use is arithmetic rather than sentiment. If you are holding a leveraged position for more than a day, funding is a real cost that belongs in the trade, next to the fees. Our profit and loss calculator and paper trading both charge it the way an exchange does, so a carried position shows the drag instead of hiding it.
7yP2FF1V_i.id: Kegunaan lainnya soal hitungan, bukan sentimen. Kalau kamu menahan posisi ber-leverage lebih dari sehari, funding adalah biaya nyata yang harus masuk hitungan trade, di samping biaya trading. Kalkulator untung-rugi dan paper trading kami sama-sama mengenakannya seperti exchange, jadi posisi yang ditahan menunjukkan beban itu, bukan menyembunyikannya.

VjqnKxbpiE.en: Rates come from each venue's own public funding endpoint, refreshed continuously, alongside the mark price and open interest for the same contract. Where several venues list the same coin the page shows the aggregated view; where only one does, it is that one. Nothing here is a prediction of the next rate - it is the rate currently in force.
VjqnKxbpiE.id: Rate diambil dari endpoint funding publik milik masing-masing exchange, diperbarui terus-menerus, bersama mark price dan open interest untuk kontrak yang sama. Kalau beberapa exchange me-listing koin yang sama, halaman ini menampilkan data gabungannya; kalau hanya satu, ya data exchange itu. Tidak ada yang berupa prediksi rate berikutnya di sini - yang ditampilkan adalah rate yang sedang berlaku.

Lll0iY7xH2.en: Free as JSON, no key: GET https://marginpad.io/api/v1/funding returns every listed perpetual with its funding rate, price, 24-hour change and open interest, and ts as the measurement time. Open interest on its own is at /api/v1/open-interest and the share of accounts long versus short at /api/v1/long-short.
Lll0iY7xH2.id: Gratis dalam format JSON, tanpa key: GET https://marginpad.io/api/v1/funding mengembalikan setiap perpetual yang terdaftar beserta funding rate, harga, perubahan 24 jam, dan open interest-nya, dengan ts sebagai waktu pengukuran. Open interest saja ada di /api/v1/open-interest, dan porsi akun long versus short di /api/v1/long-short.

eODir8nGgc.en: Longs pay shorts. It is the market's way of pulling a perpetual contract back to the spot price: when more leverage wants the upside, the perpetual trades above spot and the holders of that upside pay a periodic fee to the other side until the gap closes. Persistent positive funding means the crowd is long and paying for it.
eODir8nGgc.id: Long membayar short. Ini cara pasar menarik kontrak perpetual kembali ke harga spot: saat lebih banyak leverage mengincar kenaikan, harga perpetual berada di atas spot dan pemegang posisi naik itu membayar biaya berkala ke sisi lawan sampai selisihnya menutup. Funding positif yang bertahan lama berarti mayoritas sedang long dan membayar untuk itu.

ViBglp3yhd.en: It is a positioning fact rather than a direction. Negative funding means shorts are crowded and paying longs to stay short, which does make a squeeze cheaper to sit through if you are on the other side. But funding has stayed negative through long declines, so treat it as a description of who is paying, not a forecast.
ViBglp3yhd.id: Ini fakta soal posisi pasar, bukan arah harga. Funding negatif berarti short sedang ramai dan membayar long untuk tetap short, yang memang membuat squeeze lebih murah untuk ditunggu kalau kamu ada di sisi seberang. Tapi funding pernah bertahan negatif sepanjang penurunan panjang, jadi anggap ini gambaran siapa yang membayar, bukan ramalan.

M16WhPBtnk.en: How much does funding actually cost?

1l7x7QfgFf.en: The rate is applied to the notional of the position, so leverage multiplies its effect on your margin. At 0.01% every eight hours - a very ordinary rate - a position opened at twenty times leverage pays about 0.6% of the posted margin per day. Over a week that is meaningful. Our calculators and paper trading charge it on the same schedule, which is the simplest way to see it on a real position.
1l7x7QfgFf.id: Rate dikenakan pada nilai nosional posisi, jadi leverage melipatgandakan efeknya pada margin-mu. Di 0.01% setiap delapan jam - rate yang sangat biasa - posisi yang dibuka dengan leverage dua puluh kali membayar sekitar 0.6% dari margin yang disetor per hari. Dalam seminggu, itu sudah terasa. Kalkulator dan paper trading kami mengenakannya dengan jadwal yang sama, dan itu cara paling gampang untuk melihat efeknya di posisi nyata.

LjjT77MmUJ.en: Every eight hours on most centralised venues (typically 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC), and hourly on Hyperliquid. You pay or receive it only if you hold the position across the timestamp; opening and closing between two funding times costs nothing in funding.
LjjT77MmUJ.id: Setiap delapan jam di kebanyakan exchange terpusat (biasanya 00:00, 08:00, dan 16:00 UTC), dan setiap jam di Hyperliquid. Kamu hanya membayar atau menerimanya kalau posisimu masih terbuka saat jam funding lewat; buka dan tutup di antara dua jam funding tidak kena funding sama sekali.

The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most JUP perpetuals). B-AIyGVHmH.en: Kraken is a security-first, long-established exchange. Its futures offer more conservative leverage, favouring risk control. Your raw profit on a Kraken trade is the price move times your position size: (Exit − Entry) × Size for a long, and the reverse for a short. Price ROI is the percentage the asset moved; ROE is your return on the margin you actually posted, which Kraken's leverage multiplies. Kraken is the trust-first pick: one of the oldest exchanges still standing, with a strong security record and, importantly, one of the few majors that serves US traders. Its leverage cap is a conservative 50x - a feature, not a bug, for anyone who values a wider liquidation buffer over headline numbers.

Profit mentah sebuah trade di Kraken adalah pergerakan harga dikali ukuran posisimu: (Exit − Entry) × Size untuk long, dan kebalikannya untuk short. ROI harga adalah persentase pergerakan aset; ROE adalah return atas margin yang benar-benar kamu setor, yang dilipatgandakan oleh leverage Kraken. Kraken adalah pilihan kalau kepercayaan nomor satu: salah satu exchange tertua yang masih berdiri, dengan rekam jejak keamanan yang kuat dan, yang penting, salah satu dari sedikit exchange besar yang melayani trader AS. IQtXtGGPJG.en: On this pairing the fee gap is large enough to decide the question on its own. Kraken charges 0.05% against KuCoin's 0.06%, and because the fee lands on notional - the whole leveraged position, not the margin behind it - and is paid entering and exiting, the difference compounds fast:
IQtXtGGPJG.id: Di pasangan ini, selisih biayanya saja sudah cukup besar untuk menentukan jawabannya. Kraken mengenakan 0.05% dibanding 0.06% di KuCoin, dan karena biaya dihitung dari nilai nosional - seluruh posisi ber-leverage, bukan margin di baliknya - dan dibayar saat masuk maupun keluar, selisihnya cepat membesar:

Qe8Y4geONq.en: KuCoin advertises 100x against Kraken's 50x. Read that as a ceiling, not a recommendation: at 100x a move of about 1.00% against the position is enough to end it, against 2.00% at the lower cap. Traders who survive rarely trade anywhere near either number, so a higher cap is only an advantage if you already know why you need it.
Qe8Y4geONq.id: KuCoin mengiklankan 100x dibanding 50x milik Kraken. Baca itu sebagai batas atas, bukan rekomendasi: di 100x, pergerakan sekitar 1.00% melawan posisi sudah cukup untuk mengakhirinya, dibanding 2.00% di batas yang lebih rendah. Trader yang bertahan jarang trading mendekati angka mana pun, jadi batas lebih tinggi hanya jadi keunggulan kalau kamu sudah tahu kenapa kamu membutuhkannya.

qjk9j07Sa3.en: Kraken has been running since 2011, 6 years longer than KuCoin (2017) - a real difference when the question is who has already survived a full cycle and a bad week.
qjk9j07Sa3.id: Kraken sudah berjalan sejak 2011, 6 tahun lebih lama dari KuCoin (2017) - perbedaan nyata kalau pertanyaannya siapa yang sudah bertahan melewati satu siklus penuh dan minggu-minggu buruk.

QER_k3hNQ3.en: KuCoin settled US regulatory action and wound down US access; carries one of the largest altcoin listing bases in the industry. Kraken one of the oldest exchanges still running, US-regulated with a strong security record, favouring conservative leverage over headline numbers.
QER_k3hNQ3.id: KuCoin sudah menyelesaikan tindakan regulator AS dan menutup akses dari AS; punya salah satu basis listing altcoin terbesar di industri. Kraken salah satu exchange tertua yang masih berjalan, diregulasi di AS dengan rekam jejak keamanan yang kuat, lebih memilih leverage konservatif daripada angka yang mentereng.

XRvrVVJJcu.en: On US access: Kraken is the US-friendly option here, while KuCoin does not serve US residents. mOpPmYjdQF.en: leverage = position / margin   |   liq distance ≈ (1 − MMR) / leverage
mOpPmYjdQF.id: leverage = posisi / margin   |   jarak likuidasi ≈ (1 − MMR) / leverage

e-R284fsZP.en: Leverage is not a setting to max out - it is the ratio between the position you control and the collateral behind it. The higher it goes, the closer liquidation moves: at 10x the price only needs to travel roughly 10% against you; at 100x, about 1% - inside the random noise of a single candle on most coins.
e-R284fsZP.id: Leverage bukan pengaturan untuk dimaksimalkan - ia adalah rasio antara posisi yang kamu kendalikan dan jaminan di belakangnya. Makin tinggi, makin dekat likuidasinya: di 10x harga hanya perlu bergerak sekitar 10% melawanmu; di 100x, sekitar 1% - masih di dalam gerakan acak satu candle di sebagian besar koin.

UI-UXfdWXD.en: $100 margin holding a $1,000 position = 10x. With a 0.5% maintenance margin, liquidation sits roughly 9.95% below entry on a long. Every 1% move changes your margin by 10% - a normal 3% daily swing is a 30% equity swing at this size.
UI-UXfdWXD.id: Margin $100 yang menahan posisi $1,000 = 10x. Dengan maintenance margin 0.5%, likuidasi ada sekitar 9.95% di bawah entry untuk posisi long. Setiap pergerakan 1% mengubah margin-mu 10% - ayunan harian normal 3% berarti ayunan ekuitas 30% di ukuran ini.

HnetkveCkQ.id: Leverage berapa yang sebenarnya dipakai kebanyakan profesional?

Gft6SX1QrL.en: Serious futures traders rarely run effective leverage above 3-5x on the whole account, even when an exchange offers 100x. High per-trade leverage is mainly a capital-efficiency tool: it lets you lock less margin for the same deliberately-sized position - not a way to multiply the bet.
Gft6SX1QrL.id: Trader futures yang serius jarang memakai leverage efektif di atas 3-5x untuk seluruh akun, bahkan saat exchange menawarkan 100x. Leverage tinggi per trade pada dasarnya alat efisiensi modal: kamu bisa mengunci margin lebih sedikit untuk posisi yang ukurannya sudah direncanakan - bukan cara melipatgandakan taruhan.

LTefpPvoWK.en: Is liquidation the same as my stop-loss?

QW9rjS1myA.en: No. Liquidation is the exchange force-closing you when margin runs out - you lose the whole margin plus liquidation fees. A stop-loss is your own exit at a price you chose. If liquidation is doing the job of your stop, the position was oversized.
QW9rjS1myA.id: Tidak. Likuidasi adalah exchange menutup posisimu secara paksa saat margin habis - kamu kehilangan seluruh margin plus biaya likuidasi. Stop-loss adalah exit-mu sendiri di harga yang kamu pilih. Kalau likuidasi yang menjalankan tugas stop-mu, posisinya kebesaran.

SXt7hwK-cH.en: What is counted, and what is not
SXt7hwK-cH.id: Apa yang dihitung, dan apa yang tidak

ECcy32E7Za.en: A trade enters this report when it closes - by a stop, a take-profit, a manual close, or a liquidation. The band is the leverage it was opened at, so a 100x trade that ends at 2% profit counts as a 100x trade, not a lucky one. The liquidation rate is the share of those closes that were forced closes; the median ROE is the return on margin of the middle trade in the band, which is why it never reads +25,776% the way the mean of the top band once did. A band with fewer than 200 closes in the month prints too few instead of a rate: a percentage of 40 trades is noise dressed as a figure.
ECcy32E7Za.id: Sebuah trade masuk ke laporan ini saat ditutup - lewat stop, take-profit, penutupan manual, atau likuidasi. Rentangnya adalah leverage saat trade itu dibuka, jadi trade 100x yang berakhir dengan profit 2% tetap dihitung sebagai trade 100x, bukan trade yang beruntung. Tingkat likuidasi adalah persentase penutupan yang berupa penutupan paksa; ROE median adalah return atas margin dari trade di posisi tengah rentang itu, itulah kenapa angkanya tidak pernah terbaca +25,776% seperti rata-rata rentang teratas dulu. Rentang dengan kurang dari 200 penutupan dalam sebulan menampilkan terlalu sedikit alih-alih persentase: persentase dari 40 trade hanyalah noise yang didandani jadi angka.

D8NSX8Bjsm.en: Why the shape of the table barely moves
D8NSX8Bjsm.id: Kenapa bentuk tabelnya hampir tidak berubah

UVzvCOfgpe.en: Month after month the middle bands hold most of the closes - 11-25x is where the bulk of leveraged crypto trading actually happens, on any venue - and the liquidation rate climbs with leverage in the same order every time. That is arithmetic, not sentiment: at 100x a 0.5% move against the position is the whole margin; at 5x it takes about 19.5%. A volatile month raises every band a little; it does not reorder them. When the order does change, that is the month worth reading twice.
UVzvCOfgpe.id: Bulan demi bulan, rentang tengah memegang sebagian besar penutupan - 11-25x adalah tempat sebagian besar trading kripto ber-leverage benar-benar terjadi, di exchange mana pun - dan tingkat likuidasi naik seiring leverage dengan urutan yang sama setiap kali. Itu aritmetika, bukan sentimen: di 100x, pergerakan 0.5% melawan posisi sudah setara seluruh margin; di 5x butuh sekitar 19.5%. Bulan yang volatil sedikit menaikkan setiap rentang; urutannya tidak berubah. Kalau urutannya sampai berubah, bulan itulah yang layak dibaca dua kali.

RMU47yA5pM.en: How to use this on a real account

zu5bKTAmdW.en: Find the band you trade in. If its liquidation rate is a number you would not accept as the odds of losing your whole margin on a single position, move one band down before the market does it for you. The beginner leverage page reads the same count over the last 30 days; this page is the archive, so you can see whether the month you are trading in is unusual. Every figure can be reproduced from the free JSON - one call per month, no key.
zu5bKTAmdW.id: Cari rentang tempat kamu trading. Kalau tingkat likuidasinya adalah angka yang tidak akan kamu terima sebagai peluang kehilangan seluruh margin dalam satu posisi, turunkan satu rentang sebelum pasar yang melakukannya untukmu. Halaman leverage pemula membaca hitungan yang sama untuk 30 hari terakhir; halaman ini adalah arsipnya, jadi kamu bisa melihat apakah bulan saat kamu trading itu tidak biasa. Setiap angka bisa direproduksi dari JSON gratis - satu panggilan per bulan, tanpa key.

c_xrWGpQ_h.en: Is the leverage report based on real money?
c_xrWGpQ_h.id: Apakah laporan leverage ini berdasarkan uang sungguhan?

4E9gIgxoOs.en: No. It is measured on paper trades filled server-side at real live prices with real venue fees, funding and liquidation rules. The price path and the mechanics are real; the money is not, which is also why it is the only leverage dataset that can be published in full.
4E9gIgxoOs.id: Tidak. Laporan ini diukur dari paper trade yang dieksekusi di server dengan harga live sungguhan, biaya exchange sungguhan, funding, dan aturan likuidasi. Pergerakan harga dan mekanismenya nyata; uangnya tidak, dan itu juga alasan kenapa ini satu-satunya dataset leverage yang bisa dipublikasikan secara lengkap.

2NJhCaFY04.en: Why median ROE instead of average?

eWNb_W18R_.en: Because the average of a leverage band is dominated by a handful of extreme accounts and says nothing about a typical trade - the top band once averaged +25,776%. The median is the return of the middle trade, which is the number that describes what usually happens.

YWUpm9ke7O.en: What is a leverage trading simulator?

JzYayjgbdJ.en: A leverage trading simulator lets you open leveraged long and short positions with virtual money at real market prices. Leverage multiplies both your profit and your loss: a 10x position gains or loses 10% of your margin for every 1% the price moves - and if the move goes far enough against you, the position is liquidated and the margin is gone. That mechanic is exactly what wipes out most new leverage traders, and it is exactly what a simulator lets you experience for free.
JzYayjgbdJ.id: Simulator trading leverage membuatmu bisa membuka posisi long dan short ber-leverage dengan uang virtual di harga pasar sungguhan. Leverage melipatgandakan untung sekaligus rugimu: posisi 10x untung atau rugi 10% dari margin untuk setiap pergerakan harga 1% - dan kalau harga bergerak cukup jauh melawanmu, posisi dilikuidasi dan margin-nya hilang. Mekanisme itulah yang menghabisi sebagian besar trader leverage baru, dan itulah yang bisa kamu rasakan gratis di simulator.

Al9JmF4jy9.en: MarginPad simulates it honestly: the liquidation price is computed with the same isolated-margin formula real futures exchanges use, including a maintenance-margin buffer. A 100x position that would blow up in a real account blows up here too, at the same price.
Al9JmF4jy9.id: MarginPad mensimulasikannya dengan jujur: harga likuidasi dihitung dengan rumus isolated margin yang sama dengan yang dipakai exchange futures sungguhan, termasuk buffer maintenance margin. Posisi 100x yang akan meledak di akun sungguhan juga meledak di sini, di harga yang sama.

Rh-n6mfKtR.en: Leverage is the single most common way new traders lose their first account. Not because they picked the wrong coin - because they never felt how fast 50x moves against them until real money was on the line. In a simulator you can deliberately burn positions at every leverage tier and build an instinct for what each multiplier actually feels like: how tight the stop has to be, how much noise a level absorbs, what funding costs over days.
Rh-n6mfKtR.id: Leverage adalah cara paling umum trader baru kehilangan akun pertama mereka. Bukan karena salah pilih koin - tapi karena mereka tidak pernah merasakan secepat apa 50x berbalik melawan mereka sampai uang sungguhan dipertaruhkan. Di simulator kamu bisa sengaja menghanguskan posisi di setiap tingkat leverage dan membangun insting tentang rasa sebenarnya tiap pengali: seberapa ketat stop-nya harus dipasang, seberapa banyak noise yang bisa ditahan sebuah level, berapa biaya funding selama berhari-hari.

dl3tgmL3D4.en: MarginPad also shows you where the rest of the market gets liquidated: the free liquidation heatmap and live liquidations feed put your practice in context - you can watch a cascade happen and understand why your own liquidation price matters.

jrNeEciikU.en: Chainlink perps are popular among alt traders and move sharply around major partnership news. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most LINK perpetuals). LINK futures list up to 75× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
jrNeEciikU.id: Perp Chainlink populer di kalangan trader altcoin dan bergerak tajam setiap ada berita kemitraan besar. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menggerus habis margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melebihi jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin adalah Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai rasio maintenance margin (sekitar 0.5% di sebagian besar perpetual LINK). Futures LINK tersedia hingga leverage 75× di berbagai exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat harga likuidasi ke entry-mu.

Idb7eF9I7f.en: High-leverage positions liquidate on tiny moves, so they sit close to the current LINK price; lower-leverage positions sit further away. Dense histogram bands act like magnets and as support or resistance - once a cluster is consumed, that level often flips. Red (long) clusters sit below price; green (short) clusters sit above. Hover any bubble for the exchange, side, size and time.

8w_PiZlGZ0.en: How traders use the LINK liquidation map
8w_PiZlGZ0.id: Cara trader memakai peta likuidasi LINK

-dvrK1ywdr.en: Liquidation clusters are where forced orders pile up, and price is drawn toward them like a magnet - a large band of LINK long liquidations below spot is fuel for a flush lower, while a wall of short liquidations above is fuel for a squeeze higher. Many traders use the map to (1) avoid entering just above a thick long-liquidation band, (2) anticipate where a cascade might accelerate or exhaust, and (3) place take-profits just ahead of a cluster rather than inside it. It pairs naturally with LINK liquidation prices for your own position and the live LINK 24h liquidation total.
-dvrK1ywdr.id: Klaster likuidasi adalah tempat order paksa menumpuk, dan harga tertarik ke sana seperti magnet - pita besar likuidasi long LINK di bawah harga spot jadi bahan bakar untuk flush ke bawah, sedangkan dinding likuidasi short di atas jadi bahan bakar untuk squeeze ke atas. Banyak trader memakai peta ini untuk (1) menghindari entry tepat di atas pita likuidasi long yang tebal, (2) mengantisipasi di mana rentetan likuidasi bisa makin cepat atau mereda, dan (3) memasang take-profit tepat sebelum klaster, bukan di dalamnya. Peta ini cocok dipakai bersama harga likuidasi LINK untuk posisimu sendiri dan total likuidasi LINK 24 jam secara live.

9Ysdgk5mIw.en: None of this is a signal on its own - clusters get consumed and levels flip. Treat the map as context, not a trade trigger, and rehearse the idea risk-free on the LINK paper-trading terminal before you size up.
9Ysdgk5mIw.id: Tidak satu pun dari ini sinyal kalau berdiri sendiri - klaster bisa habis disapu dan level bisa berbalik. Anggap peta ini sebagai konteks, bukan pemicu trade, dan latih idenya tanpa risiko di terminal paper trading LINK sebelum kamu memperbesar ukuran.

Setiap angka punya timestamp sendiri.

wiGrbQShpl.en: Long liquidations dominate on down-moves - leveraged buyers are forced to sell, which accelerates the drop. Short liquidations dominate on squeezes - forced buying fuels the rally. A lopsided daily split therefore tells you which side of the market just paid for the move. Calm days across all futures markets wipe out tens of millions of dollars; crash or squeeze days can exceed a billion. The liquidation map shows where the remaining leverage sits, and the Rekt feed streams every hit as it lands.
wiGrbQShpl.id: Likuidasi long mendominasi saat harga turun - pembeli ber-leverage dipaksa menjual, yang mempercepat penurunan. Likuidasi short mendominasi saat squeeze - pembelian paksa jadi bahan bakar reli. Jadi pembagian harian yang timpang memberi tahu kamu sisi pasar mana yang baru saja membayar pergerakan itu. Hari tenang di seluruh pasar futures menghabisi puluhan juta dolar; hari crash atau squeeze bisa lebih dari satu miliar. Peta likuidasi menunjukkan di mana sisa leverage berada, dan feed Rekt mengalirkan setiap likuidasi begitu terjadi.

eEHUkYULNk.en: A liquidation is the forced closure of a leveraged position after its margin can no longer cover the loss. The exchange closes the position at market, which adds sell pressure (for longs) or buy pressure (for shorts) and can cascade into further liquidations.
eEHUkYULNk.id: Likuidasi adalah penutupan paksa posisi ber-leverage setelah margin-nya tidak lagi sanggup menutup kerugian. Exchange menutup posisi itu di harga market, yang menambah tekanan jual (untuk long) atau tekanan beli (untuk short) dan bisa memicu rentetan likuidasi berikutnya.

zvnw0VBs8V.id: Kenapa sebagian besar likuidasi berasal dari long?

7eVzIWEnJ_.en: On most days the majority of open leverage is long, so down-moves liquidate more volume than up-moves. When shorts dominate the daily total instead, it usually means a short squeeze is running.
7eVzIWEnJ_.id: Hampir setiap hari, sebagian besar leverage yang terbuka ada di sisi long, jadi pergerakan turun melikuidasi volume lebih besar daripada pergerakan naik. Kalau short yang mendominasi total harian, biasanya itu tanda short squeeze sedang berjalan.

aw5LPGKNuc.en: Share matters more than the raw dollar figure. A venue carrying more open leverage will always liquidate more money on the same market move, so a big total is mostly a statement about size. The long/short split is the more useful column: it tells you which side the crowd was caught on when the move came. And one day is weather, not climate - a single cascade can hand a quarter of the day's total to a venue that normally sits at five percent.
aw5LPGKNuc.id: Porsi lebih penting daripada angka dolar mentahnya. Venue dengan leverage terbuka lebih besar pasti melikuidasi lebih banyak uang pada pergerakan pasar yang sama, jadi total yang besar terutama menunjukkan ukuran. Kolom pembagian long/short lebih berguna: kolom ini memberi tahu di sisi mana kerumunan trader terjebak saat pergerakan datang. Dan satu hari itu cuaca, bukan iklim - satu rentetan likuidasi bisa memberi seperempat total hari itu ke venue yang biasanya hanya lima persen.

usnY4tMISE.id: Kenapa data ini sulit didapat gratis

yr3f6t9X1y.en: Per-venue liquidation flow is one of the few derivatives datasets that is genuinely gated. The aggregators that publish it charge for the breakdown, because collecting it means holding a live websocket connection to every exchange, normalising nine different message formats, and staying connected through their outages rather than sampling a REST endpoint every few minutes. MarginPad runs that collector for its own liquidation heatmap and live feed, so publishing the per-venue split costs nothing extra and there is no reason to charge for it.
yr3f6t9X1y.id: Aliran likuidasi per venue adalah salah satu dari sedikit dataset derivatif yang benar-benar dikunci. Agregator yang memublikasikannya memungut biaya untuk rinciannya, karena mengumpulkannya berarti menjaga koneksi websocket live ke setiap exchange, menormalisasi sembilan format pesan yang berbeda, dan tetap terhubung selama exchange itu gangguan, bukan sekadar mengambil sampel dari endpoint REST tiap beberapa menit. MarginPad menjalankan collector itu untuk heatmap likuidasi dan feed live miliknya sendiri, jadi memublikasikan rincian per venue tidak menambah biaya apa pun dan tidak ada alasan untuk memungut biaya.

pNWXTxQMnP.en: The collector subscribes to the public liquidation stream of eight exchanges: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX and Bitfinex. Binance is read on two feeds (USD-margined and coin-margined) which are counted as one venue. Each event carries a symbol, a side, a fill price and a size; notional is price times size in US dollars. Events are aggregated into a rolling 24-hour window and the table above is that window at the moment the page was served.
pNWXTxQMnP.id: Collector ini berlangganan stream likuidasi publik dari delapan exchange: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX, dan Bitfinex. Binance dibaca dari dua feed (USD-margined dan coin-margined) yang dihitung sebagai satu venue. Setiap likuidasi membawa simbol, arah, harga eksekusi, dan ukuran; nilai nosional adalah harga dikali ukuran dalam dolar AS. Likuidasi diagregasi ke jendela 24 jam bergulir, dan tabel di atas adalah isi jendela itu saat halaman disajikan.

eHJZhV1K4F.en: Nothing is inferred. If a venue's socket is quiet it shows zero rather than an interpolated figure, and if the collector itself is down the table says so instead of showing stale numbers as if they were current. Totals will differ from other trackers, and they should: exchanges publish liquidation events at different granularity, some batch them, and any aggregator that models the gaps will report more than one that does not.
eHJZhV1K4F.id: Tidak ada yang ditebak. Kalau socket sebuah venue sedang sepi, angkanya nol, bukan hasil interpolasi, dan kalau collector-nya sendiri mati, tabel akan bilang begitu alih-alih menampilkan angka basi seolah-olah terbaru. Total ini akan berbeda dari pelacak lain, dan memang seharusnya begitu: exchange memublikasikan likuidasi dengan tingkat rincian berbeda, sebagian menggabungkannya, dan agregator mana pun yang memodelkan celah datanya akan melaporkan lebih banyak daripada yang tidak.

G2Ra90PvB8.en: The same figures are free as JSON with no key and no signup: GET https://marginpad.io/api/v1/venues returns every venue with its 24-hour total, the long and short breakdown and its share. Market-wide totals live at /api/v1/liquidations and the heatmap bands at /api/v1/clusters. Full documentation is on the free crypto API page - attribution is appreciated but not required.
G2Ra90PvB8.id: Angka yang sama tersedia gratis sebagai JSON tanpa key dan tanpa daftar: GET https://marginpad.io/api/v1/venues mengembalikan setiap venue beserta total 24 jamnya, rincian long dan short, dan porsinya. Total seluruh pasar ada di /api/v1/liquidations dan pita heatmap di /api/v1/clusters. Dokumentasi lengkapnya ada di halaman API kripto gratis - atribusi dihargai, tapi tidak wajib.

Binance is usually the largest by absolute size because it carries the most open leverage, but share moves with the day: Hyperliquid regularly takes a bigger slice during sharp moves because its book is thinner, and a venue can jump from five percent to a quarter of the day’s total in one cascade. Read the share column, not the raw dollars, when comparing venues of different sizes.

Saat membandingkan venue yang ukurannya berbeda, baca kolom porsi, bukan dolar mentahnya.

n-R-qPelA4.en: MarginPad runs its own collector subscribed to the public liquidation websocket of each venue: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX and Bitfinex. Every forced close is normalised (symbol, side, price, notional, timestamp) and aggregated into a rolling 24-hour window. These are observed events, not estimates or a model, and nothing is filled in when a feed is quiet.

Setiap penutupan paksa dinormalisasi (simbol, arah, harga, nilai nosional, timestamp) dan diagregasi ke jendela 24 jam bergulir. Ini kejadian yang teramati, bukan estimasi atau model, dan tidak ada yang diisi saat sebuah feed sepi.

5DR9AtvWiX.en: What does the long/short split tell me?

-f61UcfzbV.en: It shows which side the crowd was caught on. A venue whose 24-hour flow is mostly long liquidations was carrying crowded longs into a drop; mostly short liquidations means the squeeze went the other way. The split is often more informative than the total, because it describes positioning rather than size.
-f61UcfzbV.id: Ini menunjukkan di sisi mana kerumunan trader terjebak. Venue yang aliran 24 jamnya didominasi likuidasi long sedang membawa long yang terlalu ramai saat harga turun; kalau didominasi likuidasi short, squeeze-nya bergerak ke arah sebaliknya. Pembagian ini sering lebih informatif daripada totalnya, karena menggambarkan posisi trader, bukan sekadar ukuran.

DntvMdhVrP.en: Does a bigger liquidation total mean an exchange is riskier?
DntvMdhVrP.id: Apakah total likuidasi yang lebih besar berarti exchange itu lebih berisiko?

JlwRNQKnAe.en: No. It mostly means more leveraged size is open there. A venue with deep books and many traders will liquidate more dollars than a small one on the same market move. What would indicate risk is a venue liquidating far above its share of open interest, or repeated cascades on thin books.
JlwRNQKnAe.id: Tidak. Itu terutama berarti ukuran posisi ber-leverage yang terbuka di sana lebih besar. Venue dengan order book dalam dan banyak trader akan melikuidasi lebih banyak dolar daripada venue kecil pada pergerakan pasar yang sama. Yang menandakan risiko adalah venue yang melikuidasi jauh di atas porsi open interest-nya, atau rentetan likuidasi berulang di order book yang tipis.

qhFKTbCXzI.en: A liquidation is an exchange force-closing a leveraged futures position because the trader's margin can no longer cover the loss. The position is sold (or bought back) at market and the margin is gone. At high leverage the liquidation price sits close to the entry, so a small move against the position is enough. Long liquidations are buyers wiped out by a drop; short liquidations are sellers wiped out by a rally. A one-sided spike often marks a local extreme: a flush of longs can be a capitulation low, a wave of shorts can fuel a squeeze.
qhFKTbCXzI.id: Likuidasi adalah exchange menutup paksa posisi futures ber-leverage karena margin trader tidak lagi sanggup menutup kerugian. Posisinya dijual (atau dibeli kembali) di harga market dan margin-nya hilang. Di leverage tinggi, harga likuidasi letaknya dekat dengan entry, jadi pergerakan kecil melawan posisi sudah cukup. Likuidasi long adalah pembeli yang tersapu oleh penurunan; likuidasi short adalah penjual yang tersapu oleh reli. Lonjakan di satu sisi sering menandai titik ekstrem lokal: flush long bisa jadi dasar kapitulasi, gelombang likuidasi short bisa memicu squeeze.

7nboZ1i1oa.en: Exchanges publish forced closes at different granularity - some stream every fill, some batch a cascade into one event, and feeds throttle under exactly the load that produces the most liquidations. A tracker that models the gaps reports more than one that counts what it observed. MarginPad counts observed events and nothing else, so these totals sit at the conservative end; a figure several times larger on a violent day is usually estimation, not coverage.
7nboZ1i1oa.id: Exchange memublikasikan penutupan paksa dengan tingkat rincian yang berbeda - ada yang mengalirkan setiap eksekusi, ada yang menggabungkan satu rentetan likuidasi jadi satu kejadian, dan feed sering dibatasi justru saat beban yang menghasilkan likuidasi terbanyak. Pelacak yang memodelkan celah datanya melaporkan angka lebih besar dibanding pelacak yang hanya menghitung yang benar-benar teramati. MarginPad hanya menghitung likuidasi yang teramati, jadi total ini ada di sisi konservatif; angka yang beberapa kali lebih besar di hari yang brutal biasanya hasil estimasi, bukan cakupan data.

qI8hS0GZYt.en: It tells you which way the crowd was leaning when the move came, and that is usually more useful than the size of the move itself. Heavy long liquidations mean leveraged buyers were crowded and price went down into them. Heavy short liquidations mean the squeeze ran the other way. When the two sides are close to even, the market chopped rather than trended, and both sides paid for it.
qI8hS0GZYt.id: Pembagian ini memberi tahu ke arah mana kerumunan condong saat pergerakan datang, dan itu biasanya lebih berguna daripada besar pergerakannya sendiri. Likuidasi long yang besar berarti pembeli ber-leverage sedang terlalu ramai dan harga turun menghantam mereka. Likuidasi short yang besar berarti squeeze-nya bergerak ke arah sebaliknya. Kalau kedua sisi hampir seimbang, pasar bergerak naik-turun tanpa tren, dan kedua sisi sama-sama membayarnya.

BT6fMCA-Pf.en: The one thing the split does not tell you is what happens next. A wave of long liquidations often marks the end of a flush, because the leveraged supply has already been taken out - and just as often it is the first leg of a longer one. Read it as a description of what has already happened to positioning, not as a signal.
BT6fMCA-Pf.id: Satu hal yang tidak diberi tahu oleh pembagian ini adalah apa yang terjadi selanjutnya. Gelombang likuidasi long sering menandai akhir sebuah flush, karena pasokan ber-leverage sudah tersapu - tapi sama seringnya itu justru kaki pertama dari flush yang lebih panjang. Baca angka ini sebagai gambaran apa yang sudah terjadi pada posisi trader, bukan sebagai sinyal.

d9JSLbtL4E.en: The per-venue table above usually disagrees with itself, and that is the interesting part. A venue whose 24-hour flow is ninety percent long liquidations while another sits near fifty is telling you its own users were positioned differently - often a retail-heavy venue against one with more professional flow, or a regional user base that was long into news the rest of the market was not. The market-wide figure hides that; the venue column is where it shows.

Venue yang aliran 24 jamnya sembilan puluh persen likuidasi long sementara venue lain mendekati lima puluh sedang memberi tahu bahwa penggunanya sendiri mengambil posisi yang berbeda - sering kali venue yang didominasi trader ritel melawan venue dengan aliran yang lebih profesional, atau basis pengguna regional yang long menjelang berita yang tidak dipegang pasar lain. mbFmUUqjpy.en: Over a long enough window longs, by a wide margin, for a simple structural reason: crypto spends more of its time trending up than down, so more leverage sits on the long side and is therefore available to be liquidated. Over any single day it goes either way, which is why the figure at the top of this page is measured for the trailing 24 hours rather than stated as a rule.

ClL-t8bSXS.id: Apa artinya kalau likuidasi long melonjak?

e2EOE7zUK8.en: That leveraged buyers were crowded and price fell into their liquidation levels, forcing market sells that push price further down - the cascade. The useful follow-up question is whether open interest fell with it. Price down with open interest down means leverage was flushed out; price down with open interest flat means new shorts replaced the liquidated longs.
e2EOE7zUK8.id: Artinya pembeli ber-leverage sedang terlalu ramai dan harga turun ke level likuidasi mereka, memaksa penjualan di harga market yang mendorong harga makin turun - itulah rentetan likuidasi. Pertanyaan lanjutan yang berguna: apakah open interest ikut turun? Harga turun dengan open interest turun berarti leverage sudah tersapu; harga turun dengan open interest datar berarti short baru menggantikan long yang dilikuidasi.

Sjcbpp_xMp.en: The quick answer: a Litecoin (LTC) long is liquidated roughly 1 ÷ leverage below your entry (minus a ~0.5% maintenance margin) - about 9.5% at 10×, ~3.5% at 25× and ~0.5% at 100×; shorts mirror the same distance above entry. 3o9bXVSeZS.en: Litecoin is an older, comparatively steady large-cap, but leverage still puts liquidation close to entry. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most LTC perpetuals). LTC futures list up to 75× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
3o9bXVSeZS.id: Litecoin adalah koin large-cap yang lebih tua dan relatif stabil, tapi leverage tetap menaruh harga likuidasi dekat dengan entry. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menggerus habis margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melebihi jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin adalah Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai rasio maintenance margin (sekitar 0.5% di sebagian besar perpetual LTC). Futures LTC tersedia hingga leverage 75× di berbagai exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat harga likuidasi ke entry-mu.

5Zx56dDAYt.en: MarginPad streams real liquidation events from eight perpetual-futures venues - Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX and Bitfinex - over public websockets. They are normalized and shown three ways: bubbles at the exact price and time of each liquidation, a price-level histogram of where LTC liquidations cluster, and a scrolling ticker of the largest hits. You can switch the timeframe between 1 day, 1 week, 1 month and 1 year.

Datanya dinormalisasi dan ditampilkan dalam tiga cara: gelembung di harga dan waktu persis setiap likuidasi, histogram level harga tempat likuidasi LTC menumpuk, dan ticker berjalan berisi likuidasi terbesar. Kamu bisa ganti timeframe antara 1 hari, 1 minggu, 1 bulan, dan 1 tahun.

19fcyq0HZA.en: High-leverage positions liquidate on tiny moves, so they sit close to the current LTC price; lower-leverage positions sit further away. Dense histogram bands act like magnets and as support or resistance - once a cluster is consumed, that level often flips. Red (long) clusters sit below price; green (short) clusters sit above. Hover any bubble for the exchange, side, size and time.
19fcyq0HZA.id: Posisi dengan leverage tinggi kena likuidasi oleh pergerakan kecil, jadi letaknya dekat dengan harga LTC saat ini; posisi dengan leverage rendah letaknya lebih jauh. Pita histogram yang padat berperan seperti magnet sekaligus support atau resistance - begitu sebuah klaster habis tersapu, level itu sering berbalik peran. Klaster merah (long) ada di bawah harga; klaster hijau (short) ada di atas. Arahkan kursor ke gelembung mana pun untuk melihat exchange, arah, ukuran, dan waktunya.

aMx_xBSYZj.en: The bubbles and histogram are real events. There is also an optional Clusters layer - a model that estimates where future LTC liquidations are likely to sit, built from open-interest changes and an assumed leverage distribution. It is clearly labelled as an estimate, not exchange order-book data. A third Levels layer overlays the classic theoretical liquidation prices by leverage. Toggle any combination.

yGIbSlH24l.en: How traders use the LTC liquidation map
yGIbSlH24l.id: Cara trader memakai peta likuidasi LTC

da7my5EPcu.en: Liquidation clusters are where forced orders pile up, and price is drawn toward them like a magnet - a large band of LTC long liquidations below spot is fuel for a flush lower, while a wall of short liquidations above is fuel for a squeeze higher. Many traders use the map to (1) avoid entering just above a thick long-liquidation band, (2) anticipate where a cascade might accelerate or exhaust, and (3) place take-profits just ahead of a cluster rather than inside it. It pairs naturally with LTC liquidation prices for your own position and the live LTC 24h liquidation total.
da7my5EPcu.id: Klaster likuidasi adalah tempat order paksa menumpuk, dan harga tertarik ke sana seperti magnet - pita besar likuidasi long LTC di bawah harga spot jadi bahan bakar untuk flush ke bawah, sedangkan dinding likuidasi short di atas jadi bahan bakar untuk squeeze ke atas. Banyak trader memakai peta ini untuk (1) menghindari entry tepat di atas pita likuidasi long yang tebal, (2) mengantisipasi di mana rentetan likuidasi bisa makin cepat atau mereda, dan (3) memasang take-profit tepat sebelum klaster, bukan di dalamnya. Peta ini cocok dipakai bersama harga likuidasi LTC untuk posisimu sendiri dan total likuidasi LTC 24 jam secara live.

p0r5fGiRIY.en: None of this is a signal on its own - clusters get consumed and levels flip. Treat the map as context, not a trade trigger, and rehearse the idea risk-free on the LTC paper-trading terminal before you size up.
p0r5fGiRIY.id: Tidak satu pun dari ini sinyal kalau berdiri sendiri - klaster bisa habis disapu dan level bisa berbalik. Anggap peta ini sebagai konteks, bukan pemicu trade, dan latih idenya tanpa risiko di terminal paper trading LTC sebelum kamu memperbesar ukuran.

j-6TtkUYLV.en: Decentraland is a liquid metaverse perp that can trend hard during sector rotations. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most MANA perpetuals). MANA futures list up to 75× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
j-6TtkUYLV.id: Decentraland adalah perp metaverse yang likuid dan bisa bergerak dalam tren kuat saat terjadi rotasi sektor. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menggerus habis margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melebihi jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin adalah Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai rasio maintenance margin (sekitar 0.5% di sebagian besar perpetual MANA). Futures MANA tersedia hingga leverage 75× di berbagai exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat harga likuidasi ke entry-mu.

Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most MATIC perpetuals). MATIC futures list up to 75× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
uZVbcoPuwK.id: Perp Polygon tersedia di banyak exchange dan bergerak mengikuti sentimen L2 secara umum. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menggerus habis margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melebihi jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin adalah Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai rasio maintenance margin (sekitar 0.5% di sebagian besar perpetual MATIC). Futures MATIC tersedia hingga leverage 75× di berbagai exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat harga likuidasi ke entry-mu.

B_wCGrvuK4.en: The market-data half needs no key at all. An assistant can ask for the price of BTC, the last hour of candles, current funding across venues, open interest, the long/short split, today’s liquidations, a scored screener or the economic calendar, and get a measured number back. Those calls are keyless because the data is ours to give: the liquidations come from our own collector subscribed to eight exchanges’ public websockets, not resold from a vendor.
B_wCGrvuK4.id: Bagian data pasar sama sekali tidak butuh key. Asisten AI bisa menanyakan harga BTC, candle satu jam terakhir, funding saat ini di berbagai venue, open interest, pembagian long/short, likuidasi hari ini, screener dengan skor, atau kalender ekonomi, dan mendapat angka hasil pengukuran. Panggilan itu tanpa key karena datanya memang milik kami untuk dibagikan: likuidasinya berasal dari collector kami sendiri yang berlangganan websocket publik delapan exchange, bukan dijual ulang dari vendor.

Z4x-UP2HJX.en: The trading half operates a paper futures account: open a leveraged position at the live price, close part of it, move a stop, rest a limit or stop order, read the balance, the open book and the trading report. Those tools take a free API key in an X-API-Key header, minted from the Bot API page with an email and nothing else.
Z4x-UP2HJX.id: Bagian trading mengoperasikan akun paper futures: buka posisi ber-leverage di harga live, tutup sebagian, geser stop, pasang limit order atau stop order, baca saldo, daftar posisi terbuka, dan laporan trading. Tool ini memakai API key gratis di header X-API-Key, yang dibuat dari halaman Bot API cukup dengan email.

EKp55f9YU_.en: The split matters for trust. An agent can be given the reading half with no credential at all, and the trading half only when you actually want it placing orders.

kfhMhMimu-.id: Apa yang tidak bisa dilakukan agen yang terhubung ke sini

ETGA5lM0wE.en: It cannot deposit, withdraw, or touch an exchange account, because there is no route to one: MarginPad holds no custody, takes no deposits and asks for no exchange API keys. Positions settle on our servers in simulated dollars against real live prices.
ETGA5lM0wE.id: Agen tidak bisa deposit, tarik dana, atau menyentuh akun exchange, karena memang tidak ada jalur ke sana: MarginPad tidak memegang aset, tidak menerima deposit, dan tidak meminta API key exchange. Posisi diselesaikan di server kami dalam dolar simulasi terhadap harga live yang nyata.

NPwoVqZ0h0.en: That is the whole reason to hand an agent this endpoint rather than a live exchange key. An agent that misreads a signal, loops on an order, or sizes a position ten times too large costs you a log line here. The same mistake on a funded account costs the account. Forward-test the agent where the consequences are removed and the prices are not.
NPwoVqZ0h0.id: Itulah alasan utama memberi agen endpoint ini, bukan API key exchange yang live. Agen yang salah membaca sinyal, terjebak loop saat memasang order, atau memasang posisi sepuluh kali terlalu besar di sini hanya menghasilkan satu baris log. Kesalahan yang sama di akun berisi dana nyata bisa menghabiskan akunnya. Lakukan forward test pada agen di tempat yang konsekuensinya dihilangkan, tapi harganya tetap nyata.

irfhsxMY9c.en: MEXC lists over 1,000 perpetual contracts - the widest futures menu of any major venue - with headline leverage up to 500x on select majors and some of the lowest maker fees in the market. MEXC competes on breadth and price: more than 1,000 USDT-perpetual pairs (new listings appear here first), 0% maker and 0.02% taker fees on futures at the base tier, and up to 500x leverage on BTC-class majors. The flip side of 500x is a razor-thin liquidation buffer - at that leverage a roughly 0.2% adverse move ends the position, which is exactly what this calculator makes visible before you try it with money. Maintenance margin on BTC starts around 0.5% at retail position sizes and tiers up with size.
irfhsxMY9c.id: MEXC punya lebih dari 1,000 kontrak perpetual - pilihan futures terluas di antara venue besar - dengan leverage hingga 500x di koin mayor tertentu dan beberapa biaya maker terendah di pasar. MEXC bersaing lewat keragaman dan harga: lebih dari 1,000 pair perpetual USDT (listing baru muncul di sini lebih dulu), biaya futures 0% maker dan 0.02% taker di tier dasar, dan leverage hingga 500x di koin mayor sekelas BTC. Sisi lain dari 500x adalah buffer likuidasi yang sangat tipis - di leverage itu, pergerakan berlawanan sekitar 0.2% sudah mengakhiri posisi, dan itulah yang diperlihatkan kalkulator ini sebelum kamu mencobanya dengan uang sungguhan. Maintenance margin di BTC mulai sekitar 0.5% untuk ukuran posisi ritel dan naik bertingkat seiring ukuran.

q1IfH1ARaP.en: On MEXC, an isolated-margin position is liquidated when losses eat through your posted margin. The estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate - roughly 0.1% on MEXC's flagship contracts. Because MEXC allows up to 500× leverage, the liquidation buffer can get thin fast; the higher the leverage, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.

Karena MEXC mengizinkan hingga leverage 500×, ruang aman sebelum likuidasi bisa cepat menipis; makin tinggi leverage, makin dekat likuidasi ke entry-mu.

gx97MiezkO.id: Cara kerja PnL dan ROE di MEXC

jJApzWQWoF.en: MEXC lists over 1,000 perpetual contracts - the widest futures menu of any major venue - with headline leverage up to 500x on select majors and some of the lowest maker fees in the market. Your raw profit on a MEXC trade is the price move times your position size: (Exit − Entry) × Size for a long, and the reverse for a short. Price ROI is the percentage the asset moved; ROE is your return on the margin you actually posted, which MEXC's leverage multiplies. MEXC competes on breadth and price: more than 1,000 USDT-perpetual pairs (new listings appear here first), 0% maker and 0.02% taker fees on futures at the base tier, and up to 500x leverage on BTC-class majors. The flip side of 500x is a razor-thin liquidation buffer - at that leverage a roughly 0.2% adverse move ends the position, which is exactly what this calculator makes visible before you try it with money. Maintenance margin on BTC starts around 0.5% at retail position sizes and tiers up with size.
jJApzWQWoF.id: MEXC mencantumkan lebih dari 1,000 kontrak perpetual - menu futures terluas di antara exchange besar - dengan leverage hingga 500x di koin utama tertentu dan biaya maker termasuk yang terendah di pasar. Profit mentah trade-mu di MEXC adalah pergerakan harga dikali ukuran posisi: (Exit − Entry) × Size untuk long, dan kebalikannya untuk short. ROI harga adalah persentase pergerakan aset; ROE adalah imbal hasil atas margin yang benar-benar kamu setor, yang dilipatgandakan oleh leverage MEXC. MEXC bersaing lewat pilihan dan harga: lebih dari 1,000 pair USDT-perpetual (listing baru muncul di sini lebih dulu), biaya futures 0% maker dan 0.02% taker di tier dasar, dan leverage hingga 500x di koin utama sekelas BTC. Sisi lain dari 500x adalah ruang aman likuidasi yang setipis silet - di leverage itu, pergerakan berlawanan sekitar 0.2% sudah mengakhiri posisi, dan itulah yang diperlihatkan kalkulator ini sebelum kamu mencobanya dengan uang sungguhan. Maintenance margin BTC dimulai sekitar 0.5% untuk ukuran posisi ritel dan naik bertingkat seiring ukurannya.

Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most NEAR perpetuals). NEAR futures list up to 50× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
1Auj7Okb7C.id: NEAR adalah altcoin berkapitalisasi besar yang volatil, dengan jarak likuidasi yang cepat menyempit di leverage tinggi. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menghabiskan margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melewati jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin-nya Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai maintenance margin rate (sekitar 0.5% di kebanyakan perpetual NEAR). Futures NEAR tersedia hingga leverage 50× di exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat likuidasi ke entry-mu.

mUu19RICIE.en: Liquidation clusters are where forced orders pile up, and price is drawn toward them like a magnet - a large band of NEAR long liquidations below spot is fuel for a flush lower, while a wall of short liquidations above is fuel for a squeeze higher. Many traders use the map to (1) avoid entering just above a thick long-liquidation band, (2) anticipate where a cascade might accelerate or exhaust, and (3) place take-profits just ahead of a cluster rather than inside it. It pairs naturally with NEAR liquidation prices for your own position and the live NEAR 24h liquidation total.
mUu19RICIE.id: Klaster likuidasi adalah tempat order paksa menumpuk, dan harga tertarik ke sana seperti magnet - pita besar likuidasi long NEAR di bawah harga spot jadi bahan bakar untuk flush ke bawah, sedangkan dinding likuidasi short di atas jadi bahan bakar untuk squeeze ke atas. Banyak trader memakai peta ini untuk (1) menghindari entry tepat di atas pita likuidasi long yang tebal, (2) mengantisipasi di mana rentetan likuidasi bisa makin cepat atau mereda, dan (3) memasang take-profit tepat sebelum klaster, bukan di dalamnya. Peta ini cocok dipakai bersama harga likuidasi NEAR untuk posisimu sendiri dan total likuidasi NEAR 24 jam secara live.

B9vH_Se5Cb.en: None of this is a signal on its own - clusters get consumed and levels flip. Treat the map as context, not a trade trigger, and rehearse the idea risk-free on the NEAR paper-trading terminal before you size up.

Funding bukan bagian dari rumus likuidasi, tapi menggerus (atau menambah) margin-mu setiap siklus, jadi posisi dengan funding besar lebih dekat ke likuidasi daripada yang terlihat dari hitungan harga mentah. Price ROI is the percentage the asset moved; ROE is your return on the margin you actually posted, which OKX's leverage multiplies. OKX is the venue of choice for traders who want professional order types - advanced conditional orders, TWAP, and a genuinely powerful charting stack - tied to a unified account that nets margin across products. jiuHCk0pI_.en: Ondo is the bellwether RWA perp and reacts to tokenisation and partnership headlines. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most ONDO perpetuals). ONDO futures list up to 75× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.

m1fRscidTt.en: MarginPad streams real liquidation events from eight perpetual-futures venues - Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX and Bitfinex - over public websockets. They are normalized and shown three ways: bubbles at the exact price and time of each liquidation, a price-level histogram of where OP liquidations cluster, and a scrolling ticker of the largest hits. You can switch the timeframe between 1 day, 1 week, 1 month and 1 year.
m1fRscidTt.id: MarginPad mengalirkan likuidasi nyata dari delapan venue perpetual futures - Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX, dan Bitfinex - lewat websocket publik. Datanya dinormalisasi dan ditampilkan dalam tiga cara: gelembung di harga dan waktu persis setiap likuidasi, histogram level harga tempat likuidasi OP menumpuk, dan ticker berjalan berisi likuidasi terbesar. Kamu bisa ganti timeframe antara 1 hari, 1 minggu, 1 bulan, dan 1 tahun.

8uc-rTKMtK.en: High-leverage positions liquidate on tiny moves, so they sit close to the current OP price; lower-leverage positions sit further away. Dense histogram bands act like magnets and as support or resistance - once a cluster is consumed, that level often flips. Red (long) clusters sit below price; green (short) clusters sit above. Hover any bubble for the exchange, side, size and time.
8uc-rTKMtK.id: Posisi dengan leverage tinggi kena likuidasi oleh pergerakan kecil, jadi letaknya dekat dengan harga OP saat ini; posisi dengan leverage rendah letaknya lebih jauh. Pita histogram yang padat berperan seperti magnet sekaligus support atau resistance - begitu sebuah klaster habis tersapu, level itu sering berbalik peran. Klaster merah (long) ada di bawah harga; klaster hijau (short) ada di atas. Arahkan kursor ke gelembung mana pun untuk melihat exchange, arah, ukuran, dan waktunya.

dkBuIW32ox.en: The bubbles and histogram are real events. There is also an optional Clusters layer - a model that estimates where future OP liquidations are likely to sit, built from open-interest changes and an assumed leverage distribution. It is clearly labelled as an estimate, not exchange order-book data. A third Levels layer overlays the classic theoretical liquidation prices by leverage. Toggle any combination.

sUj06nAfva.en: Liquidation clusters are where forced orders pile up, and price is drawn toward them like a magnet - a large band of OP long liquidations below spot is fuel for a flush lower, while a wall of short liquidations above is fuel for a squeeze higher. Many traders use the map to (1) avoid entering just above a thick long-liquidation band, (2) anticipate where a cascade might accelerate or exhaust, and (3) place take-profits just ahead of a cluster rather than inside it. It pairs naturally with OP liquidation prices for your own position and the live OP 24h liquidation total.
sUj06nAfva.id: Klaster likuidasi adalah tempat order paksa menumpuk, dan harga tertarik ke sana seperti magnet - pita besar likuidasi long OP di bawah harga spot jadi bahan bakar untuk flush ke bawah, sedangkan dinding likuidasi short di atas jadi bahan bakar untuk squeeze ke atas. Banyak trader memakai peta ini untuk (1) menghindari entry tepat di atas pita likuidasi long yang tebal, (2) mengantisipasi di mana rentetan likuidasi bisa makin cepat atau mereda, dan (3) memasang take-profit tepat sebelum klaster, bukan di dalamnya. Peta ini cocok dipakai bersama harga likuidasi OP untuk posisimu sendiri dan total likuidasi OP 24 jam secara live.

zI-NOJjehz.en: None of this is a signal on its own - clusters get consumed and levels flip. Treat the map as context, not a trade trigger, and rehearse the idea risk-free on the OP paper-trading terminal before you size up.
zI-NOJjehz.id: Tidak satu pun dari ini sinyal kalau berdiri sendiri - klaster bisa habis disapu dan level bisa berbalik. Anggap peta ini sebagai konteks, bukan pemicu trade, dan latih idenya tanpa risiko di terminal paper trading OP sebelum kamu memperbesar ukuran.

WLefGQGT7k.en: Open interest (OI) is the total dollar value of all outstanding perpetual-futures positions on a coin. Unlike volume (which counts every trade), OI counts how much leverage is currently open in the market. Rising OI means new positions and fresh leverage are entering; falling OI means traders are closing out.
WLefGQGT7k.id: Open interest (OI) adalah total nilai dolar semua posisi perpetual futures yang masih terbuka di sebuah koin. Berbeda dengan volume (yang menghitung setiap trade), OI menghitung berapa banyak leverage yang saat ini masih terbuka di pasar. OI yang naik berarti posisi baru dan leverage baru sedang masuk; OI yang turun berarti trader sedang menutup posisi.

2xtp2s_rbs.en: OI is most useful alongside price. Price up + OI up means new money is backing the move - a stronger trend. Price up + OI down often means short covering rather than fresh demand. A sudden drop in OI usually follows a liquidation cascade as over-leveraged positions get flushed. Heavy OI build-up combined with one-sided funding flags a crowded, fragile setup.
2xtp2s_rbs.id: OI paling berguna kalau dibaca bersama harga. Harga naik + OI naik berarti ada uang baru yang mendukung pergerakan - tren yang lebih kuat. Penumpukan OI besar ditambah funding yang berat sebelah menandakan setup yang ramai dan rapuh.

NkA9EhBB4G.en: ORDI, the Bitcoin BRC-20 token, follows BTC with a much bigger beta - the liquidation price sits closer than the leverage alone suggests. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most ORDI perpetuals). ORDI futures list up to 50× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
NkA9EhBB4G.id: ORDI, token BRC-20 di Bitcoin, mengikuti BTC dengan beta yang jauh lebih besar - harga likuidasinya lebih dekat daripada yang terlihat dari leverage saja. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menghabiskan margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa supaya kerugian tidak melewati jaminanmu. Estimasi isolated margin-nya Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) untuk long dan Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) untuk short, dengan MMR sebagai maintenance margin rate (sekitar 0.5% di kebanyakan perpetual ORDI). Futures ORDI tersedia hingga leverage 50× di exchange besar, tapi batas maksimal itu jebakan: makin tinggi leverage-nya, makin dekat likuidasi ke entry-mu.

UuCfXevuQw.en: The quick answer: a Pepe (PEPE) long is liquidated roughly 1 ÷ leverage below your entry (minus a ~0.5% maintenance margin) - about 9.5% at 10×, ~3.5% at 25× and ~0.5% at 100×; shorts mirror the same distance above entry. The calculator below gives your exact price for any entry, leverage and side - free, instant and private (it runs in your browser).
UuCfXevuQw.id: Jawaban singkat: long Pepe (PEPE) dilikuidasi kira-kira 1 ÷ leverage di bawah entry-mu (dikurangi maintenance margin ~0.5%) - sekitar 9.5% di 10×, ~3.5% di 25×, dan ~0.5% di 100×; short sama persis jaraknya di atas entry. Kalkulator di bawah memberi harga tepatnya untuk entry, leverage, dan arah apa pun - gratis, instan, dan privat (berjalan di browser-mu).

VVeHISOBCr.en: Pepe is one of the most volatile meme perps; high leverage here is a fast way to get liquidated. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position - the exchange force-closes it to stop the loss going past your collateral. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate (about 0.5% on most PEPE perpetuals). PEPE futures list up to 50× leverage across the major venues, but the headline cap is a trap: the higher you go, the closer liquidation sits to your entry.
VVeHISOBCr.id: Pepe termasuk meme perp paling volatil; leverage tinggi di sini adalah cara cepat untuk kena likuidasi. Likuidasi terjadi saat kerugian menghabiskan margin yang menopang posisimu - exchange menutupnya paksa agar kerugian tidak melewati jaminanmu. CF9_rD-Bhm.en: Liquidation clusters are where forced orders pile up, and price is drawn toward them like a magnet - a large band of PEPE long liquidations below spot is fuel for a flush lower, while a wall of short liquidations above is fuel for a squeeze higher. Many traders use the map to (1) avoid entering just above a thick long-liquidation band, (2) anticipate where a cascade might accelerate or exhaust, and (3) place take-profits just ahead of a cluster rather than inside it. It pairs naturally with PEPE liquidation prices for your own position and the live PEPE 24h liquidation total.
CF9_rD-Bhm.id: Cluster likuidasi adalah tempat order paksa menumpuk, dan harga tertarik ke sana seperti magnet - pita besar likuidasi long PEPE di bawah harga spot jadi bahan bakar untuk flush ke bawah, sedangkan tembok likuidasi short di atas jadi bahan bakar untuk squeeze ke atas. Banyak trader memakai peta ini untuk (1) menghindari entry tepat di atas pita likuidasi long yang tebal, (2) mengantisipasi di mana rentetan likuidasi (cascade) bisa makin cepat atau mereda, dan (3) memasang take-profit sedikit sebelum cluster, bukan di dalamnya. Peta ini cocok dipadukan dengan harga likuidasi PEPE untuk posisimu sendiri dan total likuidasi PEPE 24 jam secara live.

BaJy8Sp5aV.en: None of this is a signal on its own - clusters get consumed and levels flip. Treat the map as context, not a trade trigger, and rehearse the idea risk-free on the PEPE paper-trading terminal before you size up.
BaJy8Sp5aV.id: Tidak satu pun dari ini adalah sinyal dengan sendirinya - cluster bisa habis tersapu dan level bisa berbalik fungsi. Anggap peta ini sebagai konteks, bukan pemicu trade, dan latih idemu tanpa risiko di terminal paper trading PEPE sebelum memperbesar ukuran.
